role.zh: 微电子科学与工程 · 本科生

description.zh: 方泽恩的学术主页：器件仿真、电路建模、模拟集成电路学习与研究。
description.en: Academic homepage of Zeen Fang: device simulation, circuit modeling, and analog integrated circuits.

about.en: Hi! I am **Zeen Fang** (Chinese: 方泽恩), an **undergraduate student** majoring in **Microelectronics Science and Engineering** at **Central South University**.
about.zh: 你好！我是**方泽恩**（Zeen Fang），目前就读于**中南大学微电子科学与工程专业**。

about.en: I have been admitted to Shanghai Jiao Tong University and am preparing for graduate study. My current work connects device simulation and circuit modeling, while I continue to strengthen my foundations in analog integrated circuits.
about.zh: 我已获上海交通大学录取，正在准备研究生阶段的学习。目前的工作涉及器件仿真与电路建模，同时持续补足模拟集成电路基础。

text.zh: 团队获第十届全国大学生集成电路创新创业大赛曾益慧创赛道全国总决赛二等奖。
text.en: Our team received Second Prize in the national final of the 10th National College Student IC Innovation and Entrepreneurship Competition, Zengyi Huichuang track.

text.zh: 第一作者论文：忆阻器读写接口研究发表于 Electronics。
text.en: My first-author study on memristor read–write interfaces was published in Electronics.

text.zh: 参与的 In₂O₃ 薄膜晶体管数值研究发表于 Micromachines。
text.en: Our numerical study of In₂O₃ thin-film transistors was published in Micromachines.

publications.title: Memristor-Based Read–Write Interface Design for Neural Networks: A Comparative Study of Linear-Drift and VTEAM Models

description.zh: 从 VTEAM 状态方程推导读写约束，比较线性漂移与 VTEAM 模型，并通过行为级仿真评估读写分离接口。
description.en: Derives read–write constraints from the VTEAM state equation and compares linear-drift and VTEAM models through behavioral simulation of a read–write separation interface.

contribution.zh: 个人工作：建模、仿真、分析与写作。结果来自行为级仿真。
contribution.en: My contribution: modeling, simulation, analysis, and writing. Results are from behavioral simulation.

imageAlt.zh: 忆阻器读写工作窗口与仿真结果
imageAlt.en: Read–write operating windows and simulation results for the memristor study

publications.title: Numerical Investigation of Short-Channel Effects and RF Performance in Top-Gate In₂O₃ Thin-Film Transistors

description.zh: 通过二维数值仿真，研究顶栅 In₂O₃ 薄膜晶体管的短沟道效应及直流、射频性能随尺寸的变化。
description.en: A two-dimensional numerical investigation of short-channel effects and the DC/RF scaling of top-gate In₂O₃ thin-film transistors.

contribution.zh: 个人工作：验证、数据整理及文稿审阅。器件性能为数值仿真结果。
contribution.en: My contribution: validation, data curation, and manuscript review. Device performance is based on numerical simulation.

imageAlt.zh: 顶栅 In₂O₃ 薄膜晶体管数值研究的器件结构
imageAlt.en: Device structure used in the top-gate In₂O₃ TFT numerical study

title.zh: LDO 设计与验证 · 集创赛团队项目
title.en: LDO design & verification · Team competition project

category.zh: 模拟集成电路 / 团队项目

description.zh: 参与 1.8 V CMOS LDO 的电路分析、仿真、版图与后仿真评估，以及区域赛半分立 LDO 硬件调试和全国赛自动化测试准备。
description.en: Contributed to circuit analysis, simulation, layout and post-layout evaluation of a 1.8 V CMOS LDO, alongside regional-stage semi-discrete hardware debugging and national-stage automated-test preparation.

scope.zh: 个人承担团队中的部分任务；CMOS 部分为设计与仿真，半分立硬件为独立赛段，自动化测试工作处于准备阶段。
scope.en: Selected tasks within a team. The CMOS work is design and simulation; semi-discrete hardware belongs to a separate competition stage; automated testing was preparation work.

imageAlt.zh: LDO 集创赛三阶段概念图：初赛 CMOS 设计与仿真、分赛区半分立 LDO、全国总决赛自动化测试准备。AI 生成的概念示意图。
imageAlt.en: Three-stage LDO competition concept: preliminary CMOS design and simulation, regional semi-discrete LDO, and national-final automated-test preparation. AI-generated conceptual illustration.

title.zh: Codex × TCAD · 器件仿真实践

category.zh: 器件仿真 / 科研训练

description.zh: 围绕 H-diamond FET 器件仿真实践，整理文献假设、仿真输入、求解器输出、数据处理和物理检查，探索 AI 辅助器件仿真的工作方式。
description.en: A research-training case on H-diamond FETs, connecting literature assumptions, simulation inputs, solver outputs, data processing, and physical checks in an AI-assisted device-simulation workflow.

scope.zh: 科研训练与数值仿真实践；AI 用于辅助执行与整理，物理判断和结果核查仍需人工完成。
scope.en: Research training and numerical simulation. AI assists execution and organization; physical interpretation and result verification remain human responsibilities.

imageAlt.zh: TCAD 科研训练中的 H-diamond FET 器件结构
imageAlt.en: H-diamond FET device structure from the TCAD research-training case
